sentence.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí jiàn T xù.
sentence.meaning: I have one T-shirt.
sentence.note: 我 (wǒ) = I; 有 (yǒu) = have. Put the owner first, then 有, then the item. Count it with number + measure word + noun. Use 兩, rather than 二, for two before a measure word. T恤 is a common written label. Also called T恤衫. 件 counts an individual garment.
